game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream, a stream of spirits: the druid must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream: a stream of spirits
core_gameplay_loop: In Spirit Stream, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the vine bridge using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The vine bridge reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the vine bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
